what_they_do: Turgon is an AI-native systems integrator that modernizes legacy enterprise IT infrastructure, migrating, cleaning, and unifying data from old systems like mainframes, ERPs, and siloed databases into modern platforms. It replaces the traditional consulting-heavy systems integration process, where teams of human consultants bill hours to manually map and migrate enterprise data, with a smaller 'Pod' of AI agents plus a few human engineers who handle judgment calls and client oversight. Customers are enterprises with legacy IT stacks across logistics, retail, hospitality, and computing infrastructure that need to migrate off old systems in weeks instead of months.
theme_fit_rationale: Turgon directly competes with traditional system integrator consulting firms (an explicit Theme 6 use case: IT services/modernization), replacing billable consulting labor with AI agents plus a thin layer of human experts (the Pod model), which is the labor-replacement, outcome-based model Theme 6 describes. Secondary fit with Theme 2 since the agents read and write across multiple legacy enterprise systems (SAP, Salesforce, NetSuite, Snowflake, mainframe/IBMi) to reconcile and unify data.

recent_signals.summary: Added a fourth public case study, Penguin Solutions (computing infrastructure), unifying data infrastructure across multiple acquisitions in three weeks.
